name: Hotel Elizabeth
beschreibung: Hotel Elizabeth offers exceptional alpine luxury in Ischgl, conveniently positioned right next to the valley station of the Silvrettabahn. Guests enjoy effortless ski-in/ski-out access to the world-renowned Silvretta Arena slopes, while summer brings a rich variety of high-altitude hiking trails across the Paznaun Valley. Hotel amenities include an upscale wellness area with saunas and relaxation pools, an exquisite gourmet restaurant, and beautifully designed rooms with private mountain-view balconies.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Elizabeth in Ischgl delivers ski-in/ski-out luxury next to the Silvrettabahn cable car, featuring a panoramic wellness area, fine dining, and stylish rooms.
